faculty_override_note: The official two-year map is the planning default. DegreeWorks and faculty advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: ENG 300, ENG 303, and ENG 304 are required Journalism courses.
ENG 314 may be replaced by ENG 335 or ENG 395.
Two additional 300-level English or cross-listed AFN, ASN, or LAT literature courses are required and cannot double-count required Journalism courses.
Two semesters of the same Modern Foreign Language are required. One language course may satisfy World Cultures; ITL 170 and courses taught in English do not qualify.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
